g.text: 05 / AI ENGINEER GROWTH
Connect product judgment, meaning and measurement
Faster code creation can move the constraint to review, operations or security.
Discover the real
constraint
Laurie Voss’s product-engineer argument follows the bottleneck from code
creation to review, operations and security. Observe what users actually
do, which handoffs cost time and what they trust. A polished feature can
still miss the task or move effort onto another team.
Preserve business
meaning
Southbridge’s examples show row counts surviving while dates, signs or
categories become wrong. Learn the entity, grain, period, units and
source conventions well enough to challenge a plausible answer. Multiple
model agreements can preserve the same incorrect assumption.
Make expertise
reproducible
Convert professional corrections into task definitions, cases, skills and
explicit acceptance evidence. Monzo’s described gateway, sandbox and
familiar Slack entry point show the surrounding product work. Task volume
and merged PR counts indicate use, while quality and reviewer effort
still require separate measurement.
Sources: Arize · Southbridge · Monzo | Reviewed October 25, 2026
